title: Scary Inbox
intro: Swipe left for scam, right for safe.
Some alerts are real. Don't panic, sort.

cards.text: ⚠️ VIRUS DETECTED! Call support now on +44 7700 900321 or your files will be deleted.
cards.why: Real virus warnings never ask you to call a number.

cards.text: Your password was changed. If this was you, nothing to do. If not, open the Tolbridge app → Security.
cards.why: You just changed it, and it points to the app, not a link.

cards.text: Your parcel is held. Pay €3.99 customs fee here: customs-eu-pay.co
cards.why: A small fee through an odd link is phishing.

cards.text: Your wallet was hacked! Enter your recovery phrase to secure it within 1 hour.
cards.why: Nobody needs your phrase to "secure" anything.

cards.text: Was this you? Card payment €480 at 03:12. Answer Yes or No here.
cards.why: Inside your real bank app, asking only yes or no.

cards.text: You are owed a €612 tax refund. Enter your card details to receive it.
cards.why: Refunds never need your card details by email.

cards.text: Heads up: someone made a fake account with my photo. Please report it if it messages you!
cards.why: A friend you know, warning you and asking nothing.

cards.text: Your account will be deleted for copyright violation. Appeal here within 2 hours: wrenly-appeal.help
Scheduled maintenance tonight 1–2 AM. Your funds are safe. No action needed.
cards.why: Real domain, calm, and asks nothing.

cards.text: Warrant issued in your name. Pay bail in crypto now to cancel it.
cards.why: Police never take "bail" in crypto by text.

golden_rule: Scary message? Slow down. Real alerts point you to the app or official number, never to a payment, phrase or link.

quick_check.q: A pop-up says "VIRUS! Call this number now". What do you do?

options.text: Close it; never call numbers from pop-ups
Pay for the cleaner they offer

quick_check.explain: Fake virus pop-ups lead to "tech support" scams.
